title: Strengthen the goal to arity x in iota 5 7 in the four-colour unavoidability theorem
intent: The main unavoidability theorem — reducibility implies no minimal counterexample — is reduced by `suffices` to showing that the high-score vertex given by `posz_dscore` has arity in `iota 5 7` (the seven arities 5..11). The per-arity exclusion lemmas then close the original goal from that range, while seven score/fit lemmas close the range itself.

parent.name: unavoidability
parent.statement: Lemma unavoidability : reducibility -> forall G, ~ minimal_counter_example G.

children.name: posz_dscore
children.statement: Lemma posz_dscore : exists x : G, dscore x > 0.
children.closed_by: contraposition from `dscore_roots` (the score sum is 120); closes with `apply: sumr_ge0`
children.note: supplies the witness x with 0 < dscore x, so (cexG, pos_x) is a valid_hub for the exclusion lemmas

children.name: dscore_cap1
children.statement:
Lemma dscore_cap1 (m : nat) :
   (forall y : G, dscore1 y <= m) ->
  forall x : G, 0 < dscore x -> forall d, (59 < (10 - m) * d -> arity x < d)%N.
children.closed_by: `apply: contraLR pos_x` plus ring/order rewriting; no project lemma
children.note: the score cap: with m = 5 it turns 0 < dscore x and dscore1 <= 5 into the upper bound arity x < 12

children.name: dbound1_eq
children.statement: Lemma dbound1_eq : dscore1 (face (face x)) = dbound1 rs x.
children.note: relates the per-vertex score dscore1 to the count of source discharge rules fitting x, so the cap can be checked against the rule fork

children.name: source_drules_range
children.note: when the arity is not in Pr58 (the set {5,6,7,8}) no source rule applies, so the count dbound1 is trivially 0

children.name: exact_fitp_pcons_
children.statement: Lemma exact_fitp_pcons_ (x : G) : exact_fitp x (pcons_ (arity x)).
children.note: the pcons_ part of size (arity x) exactly fits x; this is the fitting hypothesis check_dbound1P needs

children.name: check_dbound1P
children.statement:
Lemma check_dbound1P (x : G) p ns :
  arity x = nhub -> exact_fitp x p -> check_dbound1 p ns -> dbound1 rs0 x <= ns.
children.closed_by: `elim: m ns rs p` (induction on the bound counter), using `sort_drulesP` and `exact_fitp_meet`
children.note: the core bound check: if p fits x and check_dbound1 p ns holds, then dbound1 rs0 x <= ns

children.name: no_fit_the_redpart
children.statement:
Lemma no_fit_the_redpart G :
    minimal_counter_example G ->
  forall (x : G) p', the_redpart p' -> ~~ exact_fitp x p'.
children.closed_by: `apply: (no_fit_redpart cexG)` then the reducibility/quiz-tree machinery, ending in `exact: not_embed_reducible`
children.note: no reducible part fits a minimal counterexample; instantiated in the glue to feed check_dbound1P its redpart hypothesis

applicability.goal_shape: A theorem of the form `H -> forall G, ~ P G` (the assumption `minimal_counter_example` is contradictory), reduced by `suffices` to a finite membership `f x \in iota a b` on a witness `x` extracted from the assumption; the membership is bounded below by a structural hypothesis (`pentagonal`, arity >= 5) and above by a cap lemma (`dscore_cap1`, arity < 12).
applicability.use_when: the goal is a contradiction and there is a finite range for an invariant of the witness that is (a) provable from a cap/bound argument and (b) excluded value-by-value by lemmas already collated from elsewhere (`exclude5..exclude11`), so the strengthened statement is smaller and more mechanical than the original.
applicability.avoid_when: the strengthened statement does not actually imply the original (the exclusions do not cover the whole range), or the cap argument is itself the hard part — here the real content `forall y, dscore1 y <= 5` is pushed into `dscore_cap1` plus the fork machinery, and the discharge only works because `iota 5 7` lines up exactly with the excluded arities 5..11.

claims.claim: The glue `unavoidability` is 15 lines over 7 direct lemmas whose child sites span 6, 13, 6, 8, 2, 17 and 17 lines; the bound-check child `check_dbound1P` closes through a chain of 3 project lemmas down to `sort_dbound1_eq`.

metrics.how_counted: the 7 children are the lemmas the glue cites directly (unavoidability.v lines 22-33); each closes by its own proof — posz_dscore by contraposition, dscore_cap1 by arithmetic, dbound1_eq by induction over the_drules, source_drules_range by a filter rewrite, exact_fitp_pcons_ by fitp_pcons_, check_dbound1P by induction, no_fit_the_redpart by the reducibility machinery — none by a single automation tactic alone

consequences: The `suffices` creates two goals: the original under the suffices hypothesis (closed by the exclusion lemmas `exclude5..exclude11`), and the strengthened statement itself. The strengthened range must line up exactly with what the exclusions rule out — a gap (an arity >= 12) would leave the discharge open, and a different cap `m` in `dscore_cap1` changes the window. The move also fixes the instantiation m = 5, which only closes because 59 < 5 * 12; the real content (that dscore1 <= 5 holds for every vertex) is pushed into the fork machinery rather than removed.
